==============================================================================
12. STRUCTURAL INTERPRETATION
==============================================================================

Experiment 314R established the correct separation between additive and
multiplicative commutators and verified the Fricke trace identity exactly.

Experiment 315R now moves one level upward.

Instead of examining only the two generators

    T1, T2

and their first commutators, it studies the TRACE ALGEBRA generated by
short words in

    T1, T2, T1^(-1), T2^(-1).

For 2x2 matrices, traces of words are constrained by:

    Cayley-Hamilton,
    cyclic trace invariance,
    inverse-trace identities,
    determinant relations,
    Fricke-type trace identities.

The important question is whether the observed transfer pair produces
additional low-complexity trace relations beyond these universal
2x2 identities.

The experiment therefore distinguishes:

    universal 2x2 identities
        from
    special identities of this particular transfer pair.

A genuinely new relation would be a possible clue that the two exact
cross-layer transitions lie on a more structured algebraic variety.

A complete absence of additional relations would strengthen the
noncommutative/full-M2 interpretation from Experiments 309R and 314R.

No synthetic second n=pq case is generated.
